units: <cite ref="Yoma 38b:13">Yoma 38ᵇ</cite> <he>ראה … עמד ושְׁתָלָן בכל דור ודור</he> the Lord saw that the righteous men were few, so he planted them in every generation (distributed them &c., ref. to <cite ref="I Samuel 2:8">I Sam. II, 8</cite>; cmp. <cite ref="U02141"><he>שָׁתַת</he> II</cite>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:2">Gen. R. s. 26</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 845:3">Yalk. Ps. 845</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 92:14">Ps. XCII, 14</cite>) <he>זה נח ששְׁתָלוֹ וכ׳</he> this refers to Noah whom the Lord planted in the ark.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 61">Gen. R. s. 61</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 1:3">Ps. I, 3</cite>) <he>ששתלו הקב״ה וכ׳</he> (Abraham) whom the Lord planted in the land of Israel.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 37b:14">Snh. 37ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>שׁלֹתֹיאֹלֹ</he>, <cite ref="I Chronicles 3:17">I Chr. III, 17</cite> <he>שאלת׳</he>) <he>ששׂתֹלוֹ אֹלֹ שלא כדרך הנִשְׁתָּלִין</he> whom the Lord planted (caused to be begotten) not in the ordinary way of those that are planted (he having been begotten in prison); a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>שָׁתוּל</he>; f. <cite ref="U00015"><he>שְׁתוּלָה</he></cite>; pl. <he>שְׁתוּלִים</he> &c. Yalk. l. c. <he>כגן … ש׳ מערוגה וכ׳</he> like a garden that is planted bed by bed; (<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII, 14</cite> <he>נטוע</he>).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:1">Num. R. s. 3<sup>1</sup></cite> <he>עד שהם ש׳ הם בבית וכ׳</he> so long as they are planted (seated in rows), they are in the house of God, that is to say, the children at school; a. e.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 3:1">Pesik. R. s. 3</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 12:11">Koh. XII, 11</cite>) <he>כשם ששרשיו … מַשְׁתִּילִים לכל מקום כך … נכנסים ומשתילים וכ׳</he> as the roots of a tree spread in all directions, so the words of the Law enter and penetrate the whole body (<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14">Num. R. s. 14<sup>4</sup></cite> <he>משתרשים</he>).

senses.gloss: ; Hof. הוּשְׁתָּל to be planted. Snh. l. c., v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10">Lev. R. s. 10</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:6">Cant. R. to VIII, 6</cite> (ref. to <he>שאלׄתׄיאל</he>, v. supra) <he>שממנו הוּשְׁ֗תְּ֗לָ֗ה מלכות וכ׳</he> from him was the dynasty of the house of David planted (procreated).

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4">Midr. Till. to Ps. IV</cite> <he>מה היה … נִשְׁתְּלָה מבת שבע</he> did David think that royalty would be planted from Bathsheba (that through her son the dynasty would be continued)?; a. e.
